title: Hera VPC — weekly 1:1 + sync scratchpad
content:
Context:
Quick personal prep notes for the weekly cadence with Hera (customer PM: S. Moradi, infra lead: D. Alvarez). This is a lightweight working doc — use for talking points, owners, and post-meeting action items.

Meeting goals (30m):
- Align on staging-to-prod timeline for VPC peering and subnet allocations.
- Triage remaining blockers (certs, egress rules, NTP drift).
- Confirm on-prem checklist ownership and signoffs for cutover.
- Decide rollback signal thresholds and fallback region plan.

Top-of-mind updates to share quickly:
- Staging cluster deployed with quantized model artifacts (v1.2-q8). Performance tests showing 13% higher tail latency under 512-token bursts vs our baseline — see HERA-357 for trace.
- KMS integration done in dev; need customer KMS key rotation window from security.
- Network team added new egress ACL (awaiting IP allowlist from Hera).

Milestones (short timeline, rough):
- M1: Completed — baseline infra templates + helm charts uploaded (owner: Leo) — target done 2026-03-08
- M2: Staging perf validation (owner: Oliver) — target 2026-03-12 — status: partial (tail spikes remain)
- M3: Customer KMS & cert signoff (owner: Mina + Customer Sec) — target 2026-03-15
- M4: VPC peering & route testing (owner: D. Alvarez / netops) — target 2026-03-18
- M5: Cutover window (tentative) — target 2026-03-25

Current blockers (what to escalate / ask for during sync):
1) TLS cert rotation not scheduled by customer's infra team — without rotation window we cannot finalize automated renewal. Ask: S. Moradi to propose two candidate windows this week. Owner: Customer.
2) Tail latency spikes in staging under sustained bursts. Hypothesis: kernel-level preemption when KV cache warms. Action: run p99 profiling trace and try looser batching config (reduce max_batch_size from 256->128). Owner: Oliver.
3) Missing IP allowlist for egress endpoints (logging, metrics). We need the full list by Thursday or we gate prod. Ask: confirm whether Hera will accept wildcard ranges or requires per-service IPs. Owner: Leo to follow up in-thread on #hera-deploys.
4) NTP drift on one on-prem appliance (has caused ~30s offset overnight). Ops ticket opened HERA-342. Short-term workaround: cron sync + restart agent; long-term: implement chrony with fenced peers. Owner: D. Alvarez.

Agenda items for the 1:1 with S. Moradi (10m aside in the sync):
- Ask about internal blackout windows for March 20–24 (affects cutover flexibility).
- Confirm decision authority: who signs the production cutover checklist? (names + backfill).
- Clarify security review timeline for KMS production key use.

Proposed talking points / scripts (quick copy):
- "We have staging in good shape but want two items from you this week: a short window for TLS rotation and the egress allowlist. Those unblock our automated rollout."
- "If we see p99 latency above target during the first 24h of cutover we'll auto-fallback to hosted fallback-1 in the nearest region; we'll need your approval for a 30-minute out-of-band rollback window."

Decisions needed by end of week:
- TLS rotation window (customer)
- Finalize cutover date (tentative: 3/25) or push to 4/1 if windows clash
- Approve short-term batching tweak for staging experiments

Action items (post-meeting follow-ups):
- Leo: post a short summary in #hera-deploys with the two asks (cert window + allowlist) — due 2026-03-12
- Oliver: run p99 profiling job, upload flamegraphs to HERA-357, try max_batch_size=128 config — due 2026-03-13
- Mina: draft KMS key rotation runbook and share with Customer Sec — due 2026-03-14
- D. Alvarez: schedule NTP remediation on appliance node-03 and confirm no impact to scheduled tests — due 2026-03-13
- Customer (S. Moradi): provide cert rotation windows + egress allowlist — requested by 2026-03-12

Notes to self / scratches (for later):
- Try to get perf baseline numbers with 1) kv cache warm and 2) cold start scenario — use same request patterns as prod spikes (burst lengths: 128/256/512 tokens).
- If latency persists, consider switching to per-request KV caching TTL 90s -> 300s to reduce recompute frequency.
- Follow up with infra on whether we can route metrics to an alternative endpoint during cutover to avoid ACL delays.

Open questions to bring up:
- Does Hera require HSM-backed KMS for production keys? If yes, timeline changes.
- Are there internal compliance reviewers who must be notified before we hit prod? Name + contact?

Quick links (copy/paste during sync):
- Staging perf dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/hera-staging
- HERA-357 (perf spikes): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/HERA-357
- HERA-342 (ntp drift): https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/HERA-342
- Runbook draft: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/HERA/On-Prem+Runbook

End-of-doc checklist (for me):
- [ ] Summarize meeting notes in Confluence page and tag Customer Success
- [ ] Convert action items to JIRA tickets (owner assigned)
- [ ] Confirm cutover rollback knobs in runbook
__comment: This is a user scratchpad — intentionally informal. Keep outside of shared drives until edited for distribution.
